summary: Phone new apps and updates require API 36 from 31 August 2026. This app retains API 36.
Billing 7 normal deadline is 31 August 2026; an account-specific extension can run through 1 November 2026. Billing 8 has normal deadline 31 August 2027. No extension is assumed.
Pending transactions must not grant entitlement. Verify purchased state and secure backend ownership, acknowledge/consume, recover on resume, and test real Play lifecycle.
For target API 31+ some vendors still allow device transfer when allowBackup is false; explicit extraction rules protect private data.

Current page says API 35+ apps on 64-bit Play devices must support 16 KB; its current update enforcement date is 1 February 2027. Pure Java/Kotlin without native libraries already supports 16 KB, but runtime regression testing is recommended.
All apps need an in-app privacy policy link or text and a public non-geofenced non-editable policy URL. Disclosures must cover actual access, retention, deletion and third parties.
Developer answers must cover actual submitted app and SDK behavior; local-only data and optional cloud processing have different applicability. No answers were submitted here.
When in-app account creation is offered, an in-app deletion request and external web resource are required, with associated data removal and clear retention exceptions.
Permissions must be necessary, contextual and disclosed. Restricted permissions such as USE_EXACT_ALARM require eligible core functionality.
Personal Play developer accounts created after 13 November 2023 need at least 12 opted-in testers continuously for 14 days before applying for production access. Account applicability is unknown.
Health apps declaration needs exact-artifact review; Chisel routines and local logs make a no-health-features assumption unsafe.
Developer identity/package registration requires account and market evidence; no console state or regional approval is inferred.
